cases.title: Measurable outcomes for our clients

case1.title: AI-powered CRM for a sales team
case1.problem: Manual lead-scoring slowed the team down and opportunities slipped through.
case1.solution: Custom CRM with a RAG-based AI layer — automated scoring and next-best-action suggestions.
case1.result: 38% increase in lead conversion, 62% reduction in first-response time.

case2.title: Multi-brand headless CMS platform
case2.problem: 5 separate brands on 5 separate WordPress installs; publishing workflows were painfully slow.
case2.solution: Single headless CMS + locale/brand schema + multi-channel distribution API.

case3.title: Zero-downtime deployment & observability
case3.problem: Monolithic services, weekly maintenance windows and limited visibility.
case3.solution: Microservice decomposition, blue/green deployments on K8s, OpenTelemetry for end-to-end tracing.
case3.result: Deployments went from 1/week to 12/day, MTTR from 4h to 9min.
